extraction_notes: The supplied PDF header title is UMW BC857, but BC856B is explicitly listed in the p. 1 device-family and device-marking tables. The p. 2 electrical-characteristics rows are shared family rows; BC856-specific breakdown ratings are preserved where the table distinguishes BC856 from BC857.
The datasheet does not state a revision, so datasheet_identity.revision is recorded as not stated rather than inferred.

Page 3 typical-characteristics plots are labeled BC856/BC857/BC858 and are treated as public family evidence applicable to BC856B. Curve points are sparse approximate manual digitizations of visible traces at labeled grid positions; no points were interpolated between plotted observations.

PNP collector-current, base-current, collector-emitter-voltage, base-emitter-voltage, VCEsat, and VBEsat coordinates retain the datasheet negative signs. Curve axes labeled in mA, mV, MHz, or pF were represented in SI units A, V, Hz, and F.
The hFE table gives BC856B a guaranteed range of 220 to 475 at VCE = -5 V and IC = -2 mA. The two gain_points preserve the minimum and maximum semantics and do not invent a typical value.

The table provides one guaranteed maximum VCE(sat) and VBE(sat) pair at IC = -100 mA and IB = -5 mA. The plotted saturation traces are typical curves at beta = 20 and remain separate from the guaranteed table values.

Cobo is a guaranteed maximum table value at VCB = -10 V. The page 3 Cib curve is retained as typical digitized curve evidence, but cibo remains null because the supplied table gives no numeric Cib specification.
The page 3 fT curve is typical at VCE = -5 V and Ta = 25 degC. The table fT entry is preserved separately as a guaranteed minimum at IC = -10 mA and measurement frequency f = 100 MHz.
